name: bws-memory
description: Memory: after a turn a small model decides whether the user said something worth remembering; if so a fork writes memory files in the background (redacted, de-duplicated) and a pane lists what changed. /remember <text>, /memories, /memory-undo. DreamPath: /dream merges duplicates, drops stale entries and rewrites for clarity (preview first, backup, undo), every 20 turns and before a compaction.

memoryDir.title: Memory folder
memoryDir.description: Where memory files are written. Empty (default): <project>/.claude/bws-memory, a folder this mod owns so it never collides with the built-in memory. A relative path is under the project.

minWords.title: Minimum words
minWords.description: A turn whose user message has fewer words than this and used no tools is not looked at.

dreamEveryTurns.title: Dream every N turns
dreamEveryTurns.description: Every N answered turns, and before a compaction, the memory is due a dream: a plan that merges duplicates, drops stale entries and rewrites for clarity, shown as a preview (never applied on its own). 0 turns the automatic dream off; /dream still works.

model.title: Classifier model
model.description: Model alias or id that decides whether a turn is worth remembering (haiku, sonnet, opus, or a full id).
